verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business plans document a dial menu, live transfer, custom greetings and transcribed voicemail, but nothing shows an AI agent answering calls, taking messages conversationally, or handing off to a human. Those features are adjacent call-routing and voicemail controls, not the AI call-handling capability the story asks for. AI call handling is a fair question for a business phone service, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human
